items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I joined the band Morris White was the guitarist.

ctx.x: Dave Rivera came in on piano and he stayed. Danny Block was the guitar player. When I joined the band Morris White was the guitarist. He married one of the Hanley girls and lives in St. Louis. Morris White was the guitarist. Then Danny Block had came in on the guitar. Leroy Maxie was the drummer from the original Missourians. His wife was a chorus girl. She used to dance in the Cotton Club. He was an excellent show drummer. But the Missourian band was not really a soft jazz band. They played shows and things like…
Cozy was a wonderful man. I played with man.
